name: hallie_holdout
description: Held-out live questions. Append new real questions from Rick and family here (id, text, category, date). Builders NEVER tune against this file; it is scored only to check that acceptance gains generalise. Same shape as tests/hallie_acceptance_v1.json.

entries.text: find me the peekaboo video hallie
entries.expect: Lists the distinct tapes whose transcript says peekaboo (Thanksgiving 1984 / Dan; Westford 1994-95 / Matthew; Matt's First Bday; Cape Cod June 1998), copies collapsed, offers to play one; with timed transcripts, gives the time in the tape. Must not claim a person appears on the strength of a spoken name alone.
